name: button
title: Button
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The v2 CTA. Primary is a solid ground-inverted fill, ghost is a hairline. Sentence case, never a gradient, never a coloured fill. Renders an anchor when href is set. Self-contained: does not fork or overwrite the shadcn button.
docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original: there, Button is an adapter over a forked src/components/ui/button.tsx. Shipping that fork would overwrite a consuming project's own button, so the four compound variants are inlined here instead. Rendered classes are identical.
